character.name: Vaskar Rhuun
character.background: Paladin / Disgraced nobility, falsely accused of treason
traits: Oathbroken: his prayers are silent, and holy symbols grow cold in his hand.
Stoic: endures hunger, wounds, and exhaustion without complaint or visible weakness.
Painfully Honest: incapable of deceit; his truthful words often wound as much as they heal.
Disgraced Noble: knows court etiquette, heraldry, and the names of those who ruined him.
character.gear: Oathbrand longsword · cracked half plate · bitter healing potion x2 · dried field rations x4 · broken signet ring · hempen rope · hooded lantern · sealed letter of accusation
character.story: Vaskar Rhuun once bore the white brand of the Pale Court, sworn to guard the child-queen of Hollow Spire. When treason poisoned the throne, the evidence wore his seal. He did not protest as his oath-light guttered out; he had broken the vow first, trading one forbidden word to save a burning village. The queen died anyway. Now his prayers return as cold iron silence, and his name is a curse in every ash-strewn hold. He carries the truth like a blade in his ribs: restore his name, or open the traitor's throat.

inventory.name: Oathbrand Longsword
inventory.lore: Forged for the Pale Court's sworn blades, its fuller still bears the scorched name of the queen it failed to protect.
inventory.description: A notched longsword wrapped in black leather, carried despite the shame attached to it.

inventory.name: Cracked Half Plate
inventory.lore: Stripped from Vaskar after sentencing, its breastplate was struck once by the executioner's hammer and never repaired.
inventory.description: A dented half plate kept wrapped in oilcloth, too heavy with memory to wear openly.

inventory.name: Bitter Healing Potion
inventory.lore: Brewed by grave-nuns of the Hollow Spire, it tastes of iron and regret but knits flesh.
inventory.description: Two dark vials sealed with wax and twine, each stamped with a cracked bell sigil.

inventory.name: Dried Field Rations
inventory.lore: Salted meat and black bread issued to condemned soldiers before the last march.
inventory.description: Hard, dry travel food bound in stained linen.

inventory.name: Broken Signet Ring
inventory.lore: The Rhuun crest was split by the magistrate's chisel, leaving a jagged line through the hawk.
inventory.description: A tarnished noble signet ring worn on a cord beneath the collar.

inventory.name: Hempen Rope
inventory.lore: Bought from a hangman's apprentice, who swore it had never been used.
inventory.description: Fifty feet of coarse rope coiled tight against a saddle strap.

inventory.name: Hooded Lantern
inventory.lore: Taken from the guard post at Hollow Spire, its smoke-stained glass still smells of vigil oil.
inventory.description: A battered iron lantern with a sliding hood for hiding its flame.
inventory.effects: Sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet when lit.

inventory.name: Sealed Letter of Accusation
inventory.lore: The treason charge bearing Vaskar's forged signature, kept unopened as proof of the lie.
inventory.description: A folded parchment sealed in black wax, soft from being touched too often.
